content: Lineage 2 server-side anticheats (SmartGuard, L2s-Guard) advertise: encrypted client-server traffic to block packet spoofing/modification, signature detection of known bot software, and explicit blocking of emulated mouse/keyboard input. Community/bot-vendor sources consistently split detection surface into (1) in-process - memory read/write, code injection, leaves forensic evidence actively scanned for; (2) network - packet modification, blocked by traffic encryption; (3) synthetic input - emulated keystrokes/clicks, explicitly blocked by SmartGuard; (4) out-of-process screen capture via DirectX/desktop duplication, which uses the same interfaces as OBS and Discord and touches no game process. Only (4) plus zero input injection is outside every advertised detection surface. Source tier is LOW - these are bot-tool marketing pages, not neutral security research - but the direction (never inject input, never read memory, never touch packets) is corroborated across all of them.
